story: Brahma was born on a lotus that grew from Vishnu's navel, and from it he created the universe, the Vedas and all beings. His four faces look in the four directions, and his consort is Saraswati.
belief: Brahma is honoured as the creator in the Trimurti, but he is rarely worshipped on his own. One 'day of Brahma', a kalpa, is said to last about 4.32 billion human years.
turns: When Shiva appeared as an endless pillar of fire, Brahma flew up to find its top, failed, and then lied that he had found it. For that lie he was cursed to have almost no temples. In another story he lost his fifth head for his pride.
facts: The Brahma temple at Pushkar in Rajasthan is one of the very few temples dedicated to him.
He rides a swan, the hamsa, a symbol of discernment.
Brahmanda, 'Brahma's egg', is the traditional name for the cosmos.
